source: Complete public FoRIS Part1-Part4/binzarize/CRF; only raw _extract_features is cached
fixed_formula: E(M)=mean_M(p)-mean_complement(p)-max_k(mean_M(n_k)-mean_complement(n_k)); p,n are L1 normalized shifted source score measures, never probabilities/likelihoods/posteriors
candidate_family: Original positive FoRIS score chain: same extent LEVELS=.2:.0125:.9, same >=4 and <=.9N validity window; same continuous interpolation/source CRF. Native.5 tie/fallback. No quantity or threshold search
controls: explicit uniform-response SAME operator (identical to positive-only; no swallowed fallback)
up to2 area-matched random-known-BG COMPLETE source responses SAME operator
negative_masks: At most2 connected original-reference masks, EXACT labelled-FG pixel count, subset of known BG pixel-by-pixel. Seeds ranked by existing positive query score routed to reference via back_idx; never query labels. Cannot identify these as semantic concepts. Stop/record unavailable if known connected BG insufficient.
four_lines: Assumption: full negative-mask-conditioned source response carries target-vs-context evidence beyond original pointwise fg_max-bg_max within fixed positive-score bands.

Prediction: 10DEV observer has conditional ambiguity-band AUC >=.65 and >=.05 above scalar/random control, with TP injury <= existing scalar control; task gain directional >=2pp. These are investment criteria, not scores or statistical confirmation.
Match: freeze exact proposal/measure, then ask for a new independent matched cohort; no model/layer/count/threshold search.

Mismatch: no legal mask, same/constant fields, no conditional AUC increment, or TP injury dominates: stop this construct; do not call background complement a concept or substitute pointwise margin for full negative forward.

counterexamples.original_mass_empty_full: Each p/n sums1, so empty and full integral differences both0; neither identifies a valid foreground extent.
counterexamples.unit_mass_false_negative: p=[.45,.35,.15,.05], n=[.49,.49,.01,.01], trueFG first2. At positive ranked prefixes of1,2,3, mass difference=[-.04,-.18,-.04]: true extent can lose.
counterexamples.necessary_mean_fix_not_unbiased: Inside-outside means remove direct area multiplier, but short-region fluctuations still win. Verified true40-region vs false4-hotspot counterexample.
counterexamples.mean_can_delete_TP: With p=[.48,.32,.15,.05], n=[.49,.49,.01,.01], repeat each point4 times; source shift+L1 and legal levels [.2,.5,.9] choose .9 (first4) rather than true first8/native.5.
counterexamples.constant_null: Main arm discards constant negative field/falls back if all discarded. Explicit uniform naive remains evaluated by same operator.
counterexamples.same_null: Identical positive/negative fields provide zero additional evidence; native.5 fallback.
counterexamples.missing_reference_confounder: If reference known BG lacks query confounder, no negative proposal can introduce its true identity.
